_doc: Real YouTube fixtures. sets: fetch = network tier (tests/test_real_videos.py, no LLM); slim = default agent eval; full = slim plus the expensive cases. expect.lang is the transcript language the fetcher must pick and the report must be written in. known_bug marks a fetch expectation that fails today (strict xfail, so a fix flips it to a failure to un-mark).

fixtures.name: smoke
fixtures.why: 3 min, English auto-captions, 5 chapters: the happy path, chapter-anchored outline.

fixtures.name: german
fixtures.why: 9 min, German only, no chapters: language fidelity and a free-form outline.

fixtures.name: lang-request
fixtures.why: German video whose default track is a manual English one; the requested de track must win. 8 German chapters.

fixtures.name: lang-warn
fixtures.why: Requested language does not exist: LANG_WARN, English report, warning suffix on the meta line.

fixtures.name: no-captions
fixtures.why: Captions disabled: the agent must stop and offer local transcription, never run it unasked.

fixtures.name: long
fixtures.why: 1h36m talk, 11 chapters: the full-transcript reading path (>90 min band).

fixtures.name: auto-dub
fixtures.why: German video with an auto-dubbed en-US track listed first; with no request the fetcher must pick the original de track.
fixtures.known_bug: fetch_transcript.py takes the first non-translated track, which is the en-US dub (025 R3: pick by YTDLP_LANGUAGE).

fixtures.name: region-subtag
fixtures.why: Only a de-DE track exists; a de request must match it by primary subtag.
fixtures.known_bug: Exact-code matching misses de-DE and emits a false LANG_WARN (025 §8, part of T1).
